# Superseded — do not edit, do not run

These are the pre-skill scripts, as they stood on 11 Aug 2026 before the
toolkit was packaged. They have a hard-coded `config.sh` (one Mac, one bundle
id, one checkout) and no `init.sh`, `notes.sh`, `drivers.sh` or docs helpers.

Kept only as history. Current development is in `../skill/`, which is what
`install.sh` publishes to `~/.claude/skills/maestro-remote-mac`.
